title: Error Correction
description: Add a few check bits, cleverly placed, and a flipped bit can be found and flipped back. Unlocks the Error-Correcting Code.

puzzle.goal: A Hamming code uses r check bits on a block of 2^r − 1 bits. Write the share C of the bits that carry data.
puzzle.name: Useful fraction
puzzle.ask: Find C for r = 3 (the 7-bit code, 4 of data).
puzzle.method: r check bits can name 2^r − 1 places for a single error; the rest of the block is data.
